name: Raven

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.summary: Imitates simple sounds it has heard; a DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check spots the fake.
traits.text: The raven can imitate simple sounds it has heard, such as a whisper or a chitter. A creature that hears the sound can tell it is an imitation by succeeding on a DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Beak
actions.summary: Pecks a target for 1 Piercing damage.

summary: Pecks from the air and wheels away; mostly a watcher, rarely a fighter.
